deploy-bot: Starting deploy for service=ordering tag=v1.4.2 env=prod-canary. Running migration job 2026_03_add_user_profile_idx on db-primary-1 (shard users-01). concurrency=8
alex: +cc @maria seeing this — that index touched a hot relation on staging last week
maria: yeah, staging had lock spikes when concurrency > 4, replication lag climbed too
sam: what's our abort threshold? do we kill the migration or throttle?
priya: runner default has statement_timeout=5m and max-retry=2; no automatic abort for locks
deploy-bot: Migration job started (pid=8421). SQL sample:
```
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_user_profiles_profile_id ON user_profiles(profile_id);
```
oncall-bot: Quick check: replication lag users-01 = 3s, cpu ok
deploy-bot: Observed lock wait: 12s on relation user_profiles from pid=8790 (readers)
maria: ugh. If this gets to 30s we'll see read tail latencies. Suggest reduce concurrency to 2
alex: agree with maria, prefer throttle over abort unless lag > 30s or wait > 60s
sam: +1. Throttle to 2 now and monitor. If backpressure persists we'll revert to a no-index deploy and schedule index during off-peak
deploy-bot: Updating migration runner: setting --concurrency=2 (requested by sam). New migration instance started pid=8483
priya: noted, logging the change in the release notes draft under "deploy mitigation"
deploy-bot: Replication lag check after throttle: users-01 lag=5s; lock waits reduced to 4s
alex: good, keep an eye on read P99s for orders endpoint
oncall-bot: Orders P99 spike = +9% for last 2m, not critical but visible
maria: that's expected while index fill runs, still within SLOs. Keep throttle
deploy-bot: Migration finished for users-01 (2026_03_add_user_profile_idx) status=success duration=00:09:42 final_rows=indexed~3.2M
priya: nice. I'll add a note: built with concurrency=2 to avoid production lock storms
sam: we should add a quick runbook bullet: "If index migration locks, reduce concurrency -> monitor replication lag and read latencies -> if lag>30s or lock>60s abort and rollback"
alex: file that under eng-releases/runbook and link from the release notes
oncall-bot: Canary deploy finished: all canary checks green, promote to prod.
deploy-bot: Full prod deploy complete tag=v1.4.2. Migration jobs: completed 1/1. No rollback required.
maria: :thumbsup: good call throttling early
priya: I'll append a short note to the release notes and add the SQL sample and concurrency decision
alex: no postmortem needed, just a runbook update. thanks everyone
oncall-bot: Alert cleared: migration-lock-warning (auto)
